import sys, pathlib, hashlib, json
def forbid_external(event, args):
    if event in {"socket.connect", "subprocess.Popen", "os.system", "os.posix_spawn", "sqlite3.connect"}:
        raise RuntimeError("External I/O forbidden in parser unit run")
sys.addaudithook(forbid_external)
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("src").resolve()))
import pytest
files = ["tests/test_parser_interception.py", "tests/test_parser_interception_review_responses.py", "tests/test_parser_orchestrator.py", "tests/test_parser_debug_bundle_safety.py"]
sources = files + ["src/parser_interception.py", "src/browser_session.py", "src/core/parser_debug_artifacts.py"]
print(json.dumps({"source_sha256": {p: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sources}, "external_io_guard": True, "conftest_loaded": False}))
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(["--noconftest", "-o", "addopts=", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-q"] + files))
